selection.basis: The next ten evidence-found ledger-only fields in the fresh queue after excluding the Specialized Roubaix Tiagra entry already audited and left unresolved in B85. These exact fields have accepted source IDs but no source-reuse disposition; this audit only checks local source/fact alignment and does not add fresh external evidence.

research_route.action: One read-only Luna Max audit, sequentially checking each exact catalog record, named research attempt, and accepted source record. No browsing, writes, new source records, or new research attempts.
research_route.acceptance_rule: Add resolution.kind=source-reuse only when an accepted source directly supports the exact value or documented claim already recorded for the exact model. Preserve caveats: suggested/reference or foreign-currency prices do not establish current mainland checkout, stock, or fulfillment; a purchase page does not prove current availability; frame-weight values must identify frame-only versus complete build and size; stiffness evidence must distinguish qualitative owner impressions from measured frame-only data.
research_route.stop_rule: Audit only these ten frozen fields across seven exact models. Leave mismatch, ambiguity, or absent direct support unresolved with a concise reason; do not substitute sibling trims, infer values, change catalog facts, or add new sources.

done_criteria: Return field-by-field source/fact matches and caveats for the ten frozen targets.
Integrate only justified source-reuse resolutions and record unresolved fields; no catalog fact or source record changes.
Run npm run validate, npm run research:check, and coverage:check; run coverage:accept only if required. Do not rerun npm run check for metadata-only changes.
Local B86 only; no push, pull request, merge, publication, or production action.
